title: Zesty Korean Linguine Pasta Hwajeon
description: A salty, fluffy, and comforting Korean dish featuring linguine pasta, perfect for a sick day, infused with low-calorie friendly ingredients in the form of hwajeon.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the linguine pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a small bowl, whisk together the infuse oil, soy sauce, and sesame oil to make the sauce.
In a large skillet, heat the sauce over medium heat and add the minced garlic, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chopped green onions to the skillet and cook for an additional 1 minute until wilted.
Drain the cooked linguine pasta and add it to the skillet, tossing to combine with the sauce and green onions.
Season the pasta with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the pasta to a serving dish and sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds.
Serve the Zesty Korean Linguine Pasta Hwajeon hot, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
